name: Westland
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Westland for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, including the free Crafts, Cookies and Claus at Westland Public Library on December 7. The magic runs from the Wayne County LightFest, open Wednesday to Sunday evenings through December 24, to the Westland Winter Market and Santa Day at Westland Historic Village Park. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Westland

  • 5 Christmas events for Westland families
  • Free: Crafts, Cookies and Claus at Westland Public Library, December 7, 6 to 8 pm
  • Meet Santa: library pictures with Santa by the fireplace, plus Santa Day at Westland Historic Village Park
  • Lights: Wayne County LightFest, Wednesday to Sunday, 6 to 10 pm, through December 24
  • Season: through December 24, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Westland families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Detroit, which covers the Detroit Symphony, Winter Wonders at Hudson's Detroit and Holiday Nights in Greenfield Village.
